# duckTyped

> Free developer tools, troubleshooting guides, and original technical research.

The links below provide Markdown copies of selected public pages. Each copy
identifies its canonical HTML source and includes the same article content.
Commands use example targets unless stated otherwise. Public lookup results may
be cached and do not reproduce a private network or every user's connection.
The September 2026 SSL survey is an archived snapshot, not a live status check.
Browser tools and public documentation are available; there is no supported
public agent API or MCP service advertised by this site.

## Start here

- [Use DuckTyped with AI Assistants](https://ducktyped.xyz/for-agents/index.md): Read DuckTyped guides as Markdown, find original research data, cite sources accurately, and understand the limits of browser and network tools.

## Troubleshooting

- [Website Not Loading? A Step-by-Step Diagnostic Guide](https://ducktyped.xyz/learn/website-not-loading/index.md): Find where a website request fails. Compare local and public DNS, check TLS with curl, interpret HTTP responses, and collect useful evidence for support.
- [WHOIS and RDAP Lookup: Read Domain Registration Results](https://ducktyped.xyz/learn/whois-lookup/index.md): Understand WHOIS and RDAP results: registrar, expiration, privacy, domain locks, and missing records. Find the right next check for your domain.
- [301 vs 302 vs 307 vs 308: Choose and Test a Redirect](https://ducktyped.xyz/learn/301-vs-302-vs-307-vs-308/index.md): Choose permanent or temporary redirects, preserve POST when needed, understand caching and Google canonical signals, and verify behavior with curl.
- [Redirect Chains: Find Loops and Check the Final Response](https://ducktyped.xyz/learn/redirect-checker/index.md): Interpret redirect chains, spot loops and incomplete traces, check the final HTTP status, and understand why a browser can take a different path.
- [SSL Certificate Expired: Diagnose the Warning](https://ducktyped.xyz/errors/ssl/ssl-certificate-expired.md): Diagnose an expired SSL certificate, check the hostname and clock, and find the right renewal steps. Includes OpenSSL output and current validity limits.
- [Renew an Expired SSL Certificate and Verify the Fix](https://ducktyped.xyz/learn/ssl-certificate-expired/index.md): Renew, deploy, and verify an expired TLS certificate. Diagnose ACME failures, reload the right server, and check CDN, origin, and automatic renewal.
- [Docker Daemon Not Running](https://ducktyped.xyz/errors/devops/docker-daemon-not-running.md): Fix Cannot connect to the Docker daemon on Linux, macOS, and Windows. Check Docker contexts, Desktop and WSL, socket permissions, rootless mode, and logs.
- [Database Connection Timeout](https://ducktyped.xyz/errors/database/database-connection-timeout.md): Diagnose PostgreSQL and MySQL connection timeouts with DNS, TCP, TLS, login, and connection-pool checks. Includes commands and how to interpret the results.

## Research

- [SSL Certificates on the Top 1,000 Websites: 2026 Survey](https://ducktyped.xyz/learn/ssl-certificate-survey-2026/index.md): TLS certificate survey: 1,000 ranked domains checked on September 18, 2026; 712 certificates observed. Lifetime and issuer data, CSV, methods, and limits.
- [Survey CSV](https://ducktyped.xyz/data/ssl-survey-2026-09.csv): 1,000 attempted domains; use the report’s data dictionary and status field.
- [Chart counts](https://ducktyped.xyz/data/ssl-survey-2026-09/chart-data.json): Counts and captions for the 712 observed certificates.
